primitives.name: Active Alpha Starter Floors
primitives.verbatim_quote: | **Gate `G1` (`ACTIVE_ALPHA_STARTER_FLOORS`):** Restores conserved target/carry shares and component projections for all active alpha starters before simulation and MILP optimization.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{i}': 'target share for player i (dimensionless)', 'P_{i}': 'projected points for player i (points)', 'S_{i}': 'salary of player i (USD)'}
primitives.assumptions: All active starters have stable carry shares; projections are normalized to prior expectations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When player availability changes or new data emerges, re-normalization required.

layer2.mapping: Maps player carry shares into constrained optimization variables for MILP solvers.
layer2.telemetry: Player target share consistency across simulations.

primitives.name: Trench & Matchup-Conditioned DST Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: | | **Defect 3 (`G3` Unconditioned Backward-Looking DST Projections)** | All 22 DSTs previously used raw season-average `AvgPointsPerGame`, allowing the linear solver to punt with `Jets DST ($2,100) @ KC (Mahomes)` and `Raiders DST ($2,200) @ SF (Shanahan)` just to save `$700` of salary cap.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D_{j}': 'Dst score for team j (points)', 'QBSC_{j}': 'QB Supporting Cast Score vs team j (dimensionless)', 'wPP_{j}': 'weighted pass protection for team j (dimensionless)', 'xwPP_{j}': 'expected pass protection for team j (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Dst performance correlates with QB supporting cast and offensive line strength.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When DST faces top-tier offense or weak pass protection, score is penalized.

layer2.mapping: Maps DST performance to conditional point expectation based on opponent structure.
layer2.telemetry: Dst score variance against projected average.

primitives.name: Optimize 3 Archetype Classic Portfolio
primitives.verbatim_quote: | **Gate `G4` (`optimize_3_archetype_classic_portfolio`):** Solves 3 distinct, literature-backed MILP objectives with **3 distinct QB game stacks**, maximum pairwise overlap `<= 4–5`, and salary strictly `<= $49,900` (`EQ-DFS-06` anti-duplication ceiling).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'O_{k}': 'objective function k (points)', 'X_{k,i}': 'binary variable indicating player i in lineup k (0 or 1)', 'S_{total}': 'total salary of lineup k (USD)', 'M_{ij}': 'overlap between players i and j (count)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each lineup maximizes expected points under distinct QB stacks and overlap constraints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When overlap exceeds 5 players or salary exceeds $49,900, solution invalid.

layer2.mapping: Enforces diversity in lineup composition via MILP constraints.
layer2.telemetry: Lineup overlap count and salary cap adherence.

primitives.name: Hydrate and Solve Showdown MILP Portfolio
primitives.verbatim_quote: | **Gate `G5` (`hydrate_and_solve_showdown_milp_portfolio`):** Replaces the greedy heuristic with an exact `scipy.optimize.milp` (HiGHS) Showdown solver + **Student-$t$ ($\nu=4$) Heavy-Tailed Copula** (zero `rng.standard_normal`), enforcing `CPT QB -> >= 2 same-team pass-catchers`, `3 distinct Captains`, and `max_overlap <= 4` out of 6 players.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'w_i': 'weight for player i (dimensionless)', 'P_i': 'projected points for player i (points)', 'S_i': 'salary of player i (USD)', 'Overlap': 'number of shared players across lineups (count)', 'ν': 'degrees of freedom for Student-t copula (unitless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Player projections follow heavy-tailed distribution; lineup diversity enforced by copula.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When copula parameters deviate from ν=4 or overlap exceeds 4, solution invalid.

layer2.mapping: Maps showdown lineup construction to exact MILP with copula-based dependency model.
layer2.telemetry: Copula parameter stability and overlap constraint satisfaction.
